recommendation: Keep the no-change audit as-is. No FHIR-core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-14890; future detailed CDS Hooks mapping changes should be handled in the Using FHIR Clinical Reasoning with CDS Hooks IG or through later CDS-specific Jira issues.
issue_request: FHIR-14890 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 CDS change request from the 2018-Jan ballot asking that the Clinical Reasoning module be updated to reflect the latest CDS Hooks development and overlap of functionality. The approved resolution was to update content to reflect usage of and relationship to CDS Hooks.
initial_application: The Jira comments identify a two-part SVN application: Part I at SVN 13235 and Part II at SVN 13353. Git history maps those to 8c5e8d1628de39067c0baa55d5540b44e26ecca4, which moved CQIF guide content into the base specification, and a3d51d2dfcae0c34ac2a854f44c51f2a825d2e5d, which updated Clinical Reasoning CDS topics to reference CDS Hooks. Follow-up GF#14890 commits through 7b6b5fd38b2d73a56210186666f1d336ae2b443d incorporated CDS Hooks team feedback on the same page.
additional_context: The current Clinical Reasoning module and CDS-on-FHIR topic are active build inputs through source/hierarchy.xml and publish.ini. Current source still describes decision support services, PlanDefinition/$apply, CDS Hooks service integration, and GuidanceResponse alignment, while pointing detailed CDS Hooks Clinical Reasoning mapping guidance to the Using FHIR Clinical Reasoning with CDS Hooks IG. Later applied issues refined this area: FHIR-41440 corrected the common use case wording away from $evaluate and toward services such as CDS Hooks, and FHIR-53085 moved most detailed CDS-on-FHIR mappings, profiles, and concept maps out of core and into the IG. Zulip and Confluence searches found only bot/notification-level references for FHIR-14890 and no conflicting work-group evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was needed because the current core source already preserves the requested CDS Hooks relationship at the appropriate level of detail, and restoring the older detailed mapping prose would conflict with the later approved FHIR-53085 migration to the IG.

related_jiras.note: Corrected the Clinical Reasoning common use case so it references CDS Hooks-style service integration rather than $evaluate.
